description: Scout: what moved. The biggest fund inflows and outflows for a flow window (1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD or 1Y; default 1D) and the best and worst total returns over a return window (1M, 3M or 1Y; default 1M), each row dated with the days it covers. ETFIQ publishes no single-day return, so today's movers are the flows. Filter by desk (buffer, income, themes, leverage, crypto, alternatives, core) or category (Stocks, Bonds, Commodities, Allocation); funds under min_assets_usd (default 100,000,000) are left out of the return lists, and leveraged funds are flagged. Start a daily scan here, then etf_profile or etf_risk_check on a name that stands out. limit is rows per list (1 to 25, default 10).
name: etf_movers
